headline: Citi downgrades Burlington to Neutral with stock near all-time highs
summary: Investing.com -- Citi has downgraded Burlington Stores to Neutral from Buy, telling investors in a note Wednesday that the shares have run close to its target price and no longer offer an attractive risk/reward.
